content: Large pre-trained language models BIBREF0, BIBREF1, BIBREF2, BIBREF3, BIBREF4 improved the state-of-the-art of various natural language understanding (NLU) tasks such as question answering (e.g., SQuAD; BIBREF5), natural language inference (e.g., MNLI; BIBREF6) as well as text classification BIBREF7. These models (i.e., large LSTMs; BIBREF8 or Transformers; BIBREF9) are pre-trained on large scale unlabeled text with language modeling BIBREF0, BIBREF1, masked language modeling BIBREF2, BIBREF4 and permutation language modeling BIBREF3 objectives. In NLU tasks, pre-trained language models are mostly used as text encoders.
